description: Na₃OsH₇ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4₂/mnm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight H atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.65 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to eight H atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.65 Å. Os is bonded in a pentagonal bipyramidal geometry to seven H atoms. There are a spread of Os-H bond distances ranging from 1.65-1.73 Å. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Os atom. In the second H site, H is bonded to four Na and one Os atom to form distorted HNa₄Os square pyramids that share corners with five equivalent HNa₃Os tetrahedra, edges with three equivalent HNa₄Os square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one HNa₃Os tetrahedra,  a faceface with one HNa₄Os square pyramid, and  a faceface with one HNa₃Os tetrahedra. In the third H site, H is bonded to three Na and one Os atom to form distorted HNa₃Os tetrahedra that share corners with five equivalent HNa₄Os square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one HNa₃Os tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one HNa₄Os square pyramid,  a faceface with one HNa₄Os square pyramid, and  a faceface with one HNa₃Os tetrahedra. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Os atom.
